Name: Bouhm's Pet Dogs (Shiba Inu - German Shepherd - Husky)
Author: Bouhm
Description:
[b]Bouhm's Pet Mods[/b] adds new dog breeds for a Shiba Inu, German Shepherd, and Husky.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bouhm/stardew-valley-mods/main/PetDogs/docs/screenshots/shibainu.png[/img]

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configure[/size]
When creating a new save, you can choose the dog breeds on the character customization screen:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bouhm/stardew-valley-mods/main/PetDogs/docs/screenshots/character-customization.png[/img]

For an existing save, you can change pet breed by running [font=Courier New]debug customize[/font] in the SMAPI console to show the customization screen again. Make sure you only change the pet type; changing other values may have unexpected effects.

[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*]If you like this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/33462545?tab=user+files]check out my other mods[/url]!
[*][url=https://github.com/Bouhm/stardew-valley-mods]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
